item.title: NatWest announces 1,000 more job cuts after AI efficiency drive
item.body: NatWest has announced 1,000 more job cuts following an efficiency drive involving AI. The bank highlighted the progress it had made towards becoming a simpler, technology-driven bank.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 💼 NatWest announces 1,000 more job cuts after AI efficiency drive

NatWest has announced 1,000 more job cuts following an efficiency drive involving AI. The bank highlighted the progress it had made towards becoming a simpler, technology-driven bank.

Source: The Independent | Image: Pixabay
